title: DNA-Binding Properties of Non-Intercalating Water-Soluble Organometallic Ir(III) Luminophores.
authors: Alkhaibari, Ibrahim S; Horton, Peter N; Coles, Simon J; Buurma, Niklaas J; Pope, Simon J A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究有机金属Ir(III)配合物与DNA的结合特性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系中的DNA结合，但对象为小分子而非蛋白质/TF，且方法以实验为主、计算为辅，缺乏AI或MD等建模方法，与课题核心匹配度低。
abstract: A series of Ir(III) complexes, [Ir(C;N)(2)(en)](+) (where C;N = 2-phenyl-benzo[d]thiazolyl cyclometalating ligand; en = ethylene diamine), is reported with structural variation via a substituent (H, Me, OMe, Cl, OCF(3)) at the coordinated phenyl ring. The complexes were soluble in aqueous buffer, with solubility limits correlating inversely with the predicted logP. The complexes display efficient visible absorption at 400-500 nm (epsilon  approximately  5000 M(-1) cm(-1)) due to charge-transfer transitions and are triplet emitters in aerated buffer (lambda(em) = 529-540 nm; lifetimes up to 0.763 micros; Phi(em) </= 12%). Each complex was investigated, via computational and biophysical experiments, in the context of DNA binding. According to UV-visible titrations, the cationic complexes bind to DNA with apparent affinities ranging from 6 x 10(4) to 5 x 10(5) M(-1) with apparent binding site sizes between 0.4 and 1.0 base pairs. Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) showed that complexes [Ir(L1-3)(2)(en)]Cl bind to DNA in two types of binding sites, viz., a high-affinity (10(7)-10(8) M(-1)) binding site with characteristics of minor or major groove binding and a low-affinity binding site (10(5) M(-1)) with characteristics of non-specific binding to negatively charged DNA, with binding supported by hydrophobic interactions between complexes.
abstract_zh: 报道了一系列Ir(III)配合物[Ir(C;N)(2)(en)](+)（其中C;N = 2-苯基-苯并[d]噻唑基环金属配体；en = 乙二胺），并通过在配位苯环上的取代基（H、Me、OMe、Cl、OCF(3)）实现结构变化。这些配合物在水性缓冲液中可溶，其溶解度极限与预测的logP值呈反相关。由于电荷转移跃迁，配合物在400-500 nm处表现出有效的可见光吸收（ε约5000 M(-1) cm(-1)），并在充气缓冲液中作为三重态发射体（λ(em) = 529-540 nm；寿命可达0.763微秒；Φ(em) ≤ 12%）。通过计算和生物物理实验，对每种配合物在DNA结合方面的性质进行了研究。根据紫外-可见滴定实验，阳离子配合物与DNA结合的表观亲和力范围为6 x 10(4)至5 x 10(5) M(-1)，表观结合位点大小介于0.4至1.0个碱基对之间。等温滴定量热法（ITC）显示，配合物[Ir(L1-3)(2)(en)]Cl与DNA结合于两种类型的结合位点，即高亲和力（10(7)-10(8) M(-1)）结合位点，具有小沟或大沟结合的特征，以及低亲和力（10(5) M(-1)）结合位点，具有与带负电DNA非特异性结合的特征，且结合由配合物之间的疏水相互作用支持。
